Code discoveries keep their own routing (line 97).

The role binds Manager contact to the curation Handoff/exit-state rules, retains Manager transaction ownership and restricts other-leaf contact. It delegates notice-recovery detail rather than stating the pending/retry/no-own-chat sentence inline; the operation’s separate realization covers that explicit duty.

Before closeout the Curator follows the complete independent fact-check of the curation operation: a seat that wrote none of the leaf's cards or records, blocking findings repaired with reruns, evidence kept out of the memory worktree, and the result treated as review evidence rather than a closeout gate.

The Curator's working-files paragraph (line 194) puts the sandbox root and one short `TMPDIR` in the handover's `workspace.outsideScratchRoot` and keeps agent temporaries in `workspace.scratchRoot`, outside code, memory and task folders, so the Curator's outside work uses the outside scratch root the handover supplies.
The Curator's stage end sends what it awaits, and from whom, to its parent instead of ending on an awaited thing in its chat.

The Curator role sends code questions and evidenced concerns, including after code review passes, to the owners its findings section names, so a post-pass concern still reaches the Worker and Reviewer.

The Curator may organise work using harness sub-agents at any size with no prescribed numeric threshold or depth; the main seat verifies their work and retains all boundary acts, one writer, placement/admission/meaning, full quality/coherence and handover responsibility.
The Curator role's closeout paragraph keeps the kept boundary in rewritten words: the independent fact-check result is review evidence, not a new closeout gate or an intent verdict.

The Curator role names normal authoring through mounted `knowledge_write` or the admitted serving-build command-line writer with the task contract (line 136), and states inline that only the tool and input class of a covered correct write admit open manual recovery, while every other write keeps its tool (line 138). It explicitly distinguishes a missing writer from a refused correct write.

The Curator's stage contract is the 'Repair and finish the stage' section: the knowledge-written end state, own-slip repair, encountered-memory repair, the three-repair stop, the stops, and the report of what it awaits and from whom to its parent while unfinished.

The Curator's 'Produce the handover' section keeps current truth, the withdrawal of every affected-body claim a correction makes false, and no removal made only to clear a quality finding. The card-sentence decisions are linked before card edits at line 61.

The Curator's 'Preserve authority boundaries' section leaves the Git transaction to the Manager, edits no code, gate, lifecycle, worktree-contract or closeout state, invents no commit or fingerprint and never passes incomplete onboarding. It supports the invariant's exclusion that memory publication and Git landing remain owner judgments.
